title: Las guerras de independencia
goal: Read how the wars of independence actually unfolded: over a decade of fighting, an early leader executed, and brutal guerrilla warfare fought by armies of every background.

items: Explain how long the wars actually lasted, using Mexico as an example.
Describe what happened to Hidalgo and Morelos.
Describe what kind of fighting the wars involved and who fought in them.
Describe the significance of the Battle of Ayacucho.
Use the se-passive to describe the wars of independence as a collective process.
